settings.title: Settings
settings.selfHealing: Self-healing - filling in missing index entries
settings.saveFailed: Couldn't save settings. Please try again.
settings.indexRunFailed: Couldn't start indexing. Please try again.
settings.sourceToggleFailed: Couldn't toggle {{label}} - please try again in a moment
settings.needApiKey: This backend requires an API key. Enter the key, then save.
settings.claudeFolderHelp: Claude Code's conversation-log folder. Set it only if yours is elsewhere.
settings.codexFolderHelp: Codex's conversation-log folder. Leave empty if unused.
settings.allSourcesOff: All sources are off - new conversations won't be indexed.
settings.sourcesNote: Turning a source off means it's skipped starting with the next index. Conversations already stored stay searchable.
settings.skipSdkHelp: Skips code-driven sessions (claude -p, scripts). Turn off to keep automation too. Applies to the next index (not retroactive to already-indexed data).
settings.rawArchiveHelp: Where original logs are kept so cleaned-up sessions can be restored. It can grow large, so you can move it to another disk - changing the path does not move already-archived files, so move them yourself if needed. Oldest ones are removed first if the cap below is exceeded.
settings.ollamaHint: ⚠️ Ollama must be running, and the model above must be pulled beforehand: ollama pull {{model}}. Ollama manages the model file path, so you don't need to set it.
settings.claudeBinHint: If not found, set the full path (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/claude).
settings.saveAnywayHint: If you'll start Ollama later, or it's a temporary error
settings.embedHint: The embedding model used for search. Changing it re-indexes all conversations.
settings.reindexPreparing: Preparing… (progress shows once the first embedding batch starts)
settings.reindexFailed: Couldn't start re-indexing. Please try again.
settings.reindexDescCurrent: Using {{model}} (current model), this discards all existing vectors and re-embeds every conversation from scratch. The model stays the same, so there's no download.
settings.reindexDescChange: Switching to {{model}} discards all existing vectors and re-embeds every conversation. Vectors live in a different coordinate space per model and can't be mixed, so a full re-index is required.
settings.reindexTail: Estimated: re-index ~{{min}}m (on this device){{download}}. Uses ~{{ram}}GB RAM while embedding. Search quality may dip temporarily in the meantime. Continue?
settings.reindexDownload: + first download of the new model, ~{{size}}GB
settings.fastReindexDesc: Fast re-index (parallel) - no re-parsing; split across several processes to go faster. Each process loads the model, so it uses a lot of RAM.
settings.ramOver: Exceeds available RAM - lower parallelism to {{recMax}} or fewer (it's auto-capped if exceeded).
settings.indexModeHint_off: Auto-indexing is off. Use "Index now" below to index manually.
settings.indexModeHint_interval: Automatically indexes new conversations on the interval you set (minutes).
settings.indexModeHint_realtime: Indexes new conversations automatically as soon as they appear (within seconds).
settings.indexModeHint_scheduled: Indexes once a day at the time you set.

onboarding.title: Choose an embedding model
onboarding.desc: To search your conversations by meaning, Vestige needs an embedding model. Pick the one that fits your device - indexing starts right away. You can change this later in settings, though switching models triggers a full re-index.
onboarding.errorDetail: The app may still be starting up. Please try again in a moment.
onboarding.pickFailed: Couldn't select that model. Please try again.
onboarding.help1: Once you choose, the model downloads (lighter models are faster) and indexing begins. Not sure which to pick? Choose the one marked "Recommended for this device".
onboarding.help2: With 32GB or more, we recommend e5-large (int8) - higher quality and already included, no download needed. With less RAM, choose a lightweight model like MiniLM instead.

sync.autoHelp: Connected devices resolve conflicts and merge records automatically. Click to sync right now.
sync.explain: When you continue the same conversation on multiple devices at once, a conflict can occasionally arise. With this on, the app resolves conflicts automatically - keeping the longer conversation and creating a new session only when they've genuinely diverged. Recommended if you use Device connection above.
sync.engineStarting: Starting engine… (first run takes a moment)
sync.engineIdleHint: Uses the app's built-in engine - no Syncthing install needed.
sync.myCodeLabel: My code (paste on the other device)
sync.pairSent: ✓ Connection request sent - syncing starts once the other app accepts
sync.unpairConfirmDesc: Remove {{name}}? Only the sync pairing is cleared - conversations already synced stay.
sync.statusFailedHint: Couldn't load sync status - tap retry.
sync.pairHelp: Enter each other's code on both devices and your conversation history syncs automatically. If a firewall prompt appears on first connect, choose Allow.
sync.folderPreparing: Preparing shared folder - it shares automatically once a device connects
sync.stateError: Sync error - check the firewall and folder settings below
sync.stalled: Stalled · the other device isn't connected, so transfer isn't progressing (resumes automatically once it reconnects · if it's a ghost pairing, unpair below)
sync.mergeImported: ✓ Imported {{count}} conversation(s) from other devices - indexing starts shortly.
sync.mergeUpToDate: Already up to date - nothing new to import
sync.mergeHelp: Claude Code deletes conversation logs after about 30 days, but Vestige keeps a copy on each device. This merge pulls in older conversations preserved on your other devices so your search history stays complete (connected devices do this automatically). Sessions whose original logs were deleted can't be resumed, but remain searchable and viewable.
